title: When Grouped Cyclic Shift meets masked image modeling: Effective pre-training for data-scarce 3D ultrasound analysis tasks

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《When Grouped Cyclic Shift meets masked image modeling: Effective pre-training for data-scarce 3D ultrasound analysis tasks》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】The inherent data scarcity in 3D ultrasound analysis demands data-efficient self-supervised learning (SSL) methods, yet prevalent approaches are often data-intensive.

evidence.text: The inherent data scarcity in 3D ultrasound analysis demands data-efficient self-supervised learning (SSL) methods, yet prevalent approaches are often data-intensive.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《When Grouped Cyclic Shift meets masked image modeling: Effective pre-training for data-scarce 3D ultrasound analysis tasks》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】To bridge this gap, we present Grouped Cyclic Shift Masked Image Modeling (GCSMIM), a masked image modeling (MIM) pre-training framework designed for this low-data regime.

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】A Sparse MLP (SMLP) further processes features at mask-identified valid positions during pre-training.

evidence.text: To bridge this gap, we present Grouped Cyclic Shift Masked Image Modeling (GCSMIM), a masked image modeling (MIM) pre-training framework designed for this low-data regime.
A Sparse MLP (SMLP) further processes features at mask-identified valid positions during pre-training.
